latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor iOS.

- Instantly edit and export iPhone video clips to 1080p MP4 just by describing what you want.
- No desktop app or timeline required; upload raw footage, type instructions, and receive edited video in under a minute.
- Automatic backend connection and authentication with free token for new users (100 credits, 7-day validity).
- Fast cloud GPU processing; supports trimming, transitions, aspect ratio, text overlays, audio tracks, and more.
- Clear user prompts and streamlined workflow—upload, describe edit, download result.
- Handles errors, credit balance, and common export formats (mp4, mov, avi, gif, etc).
